title: Ahmed body: CFD to surrogate twin
description: The Ahmed body from geometry (parametric and OpenCASCADE CAD) through an OpenFOAM campaign (k-omega SST, prism layers, checks per run), grid convergence and validation against Ahmed et al. (1984), a dataset with a held-out region, surrogate families with calibrated intervals and physics checks, the slant angle inferred from a drag measurement, the least-drag slant and clearance re-verified against the CFD (or stated unverified), and a digital twin page.
